stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Gideon Malick works alongside Alexander Pierce as one of the HYDRA leaders hidden inside S.H.I.E.L.D. He once hoped Pierce would share his faith in Hive, but found him too bloodthirsty.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Alexei sees himself as the Soviet answer to Captain America and brags to fellow inmates that he once fought Steve Rogers, a story that cannot be true. He even asks Natasha whether Steve ever mentions him.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Alisa Jones, Jessica's mother, is Danielle's maternal grandmother, though she dies years before Danielle is born.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: BB Urich is the niece of reporter Ben Urich and is named after him. She suspects Wilson Fisk was behind his murder.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Doctor Doom appears in Bruce Banner's hidden lab, forces him into his Hulk form and teleports away with him.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Jack Murdock faces Carl "Crusher" Creel in the ring in his final fight.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Reporter Christine Everhart accompanies Justin Hammer to the Monaco Grand Prix to interview him for Vanity Fair. She loses interest the moment Tony Stark mentions that Hammer's military contract was revoked.

stages.title: WHIH Newsfront (Part 1)
stages.text: Christine Everhart interviews Scott Lang for WHiH a day before his release from San Quentin. Scott complains she is unfair to him because VistaCorp, the company he robbed, owns WHiH, and the interview ends with him getting tased.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Micro is one of Skye's hacker contacts from the Rising Tide. He sends her photos of a murder victim carved with strange alien symbols, which puts Coulson's team on the killer's trail.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Gideon Malick and Daniel Whitehall both rise to lead HYDRA. When they meet in 1970, Malick tells him about the ancient ritual of stones that sends an unlucky member to the planet where Hive waits.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Daniel Whitehall, born Werner Reinhardt, rises as a HYDRA officer under Johann Schmidt during the war. For decades afterward he carries on the Red Skull's work.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Dorothy Walker adopted Danielle's mother, Jessica Jones, which makes her Danielle's adoptive grandmother.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: James Lucas is Luke Cage's father, which makes him Danielle's grandfather.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Danielle is the daughter of Jessica Jones and Luke Cage, which makes Jessica's adoptive sister Trish her aunt.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Gunner Henderson is the soldier who sends Micro the footage of Ahmad Zubair's execution, then goes into hiding in Kentucky. When Frank tracks him down, Micro helps the two of them fight off the Anvil team sent to kill Gunner.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: James Lucas is Willis Stryker's father, which makes Diamondback Luke Cage's half-brother.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Wanda and Pietro come to Helen Cho's lab with Ultron, who uses the Scepter to force Cho to build his new body. When Wanda reads Ultron's mind and sees his plan to wipe out humanity, she breaks his hold on Cho so she can stop the upload.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: In 1998, Varra spies on Dreykov for Nick Fury and brings him intelligence on Dreykov's men.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Tony Stark builds the A.I. E.D.I.T.H. into a pair of sunglasses and leaves them to Peter Parker after his death, giving Peter control of Stark Industries' satellite and drone network.

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Ultron and E.D.I.T.H. are both held inside White Vision's mind. They work together to hunt the killer synthezoid Jocasta.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: When Kilgrave takes over the 15th Precinct, he forces Detective Eddy Costa to sit with a gun pressed to his own head while he talks to Jessica Jones.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Eleanor Bishop secretly pays Valentina Allegra de Fontaine, who passes the job to Yelena Belova and sends her after Clint Barton.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Eros is Thanos's adoptive brother, an Eternal placed with Titan's royal family who later rebels against Arishem and leaves to become an outlaw. Pip introduces him as Thanos's brother when he arrives on the Domo.

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Ezekiel Stane is the son of Obadiah Stane. He hides from his father's legacy under the name Joe McGillicuddy.

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Fiona Guthrie runs The Old Selkie, the Edinburgh pub where Wanda and Vision are regulars while they live together in secret. The couple carve "W+V" into one of her tables.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Sprite uses her illusions to show the people of Mesopotamia Gilgamesh's feats, helping turn him into a legend. The two fight the Deviants side by side as Eternals for thousands of years.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Giyera serves HYDRA under Gideon Malick, but once Hive's parasites infect him, his loyalty shifts to Hive. He tends to Hive as the Inhuman recovers and learns about the modern world.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Hasan is Muneeba's grandfather, the man her mother Sana found by following the stars during the Partition of India. That story becomes a family legend the Khans keep retelling.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Kang the Conqueror is a variant of He Who Remains, one of the versions of himself who sees other universes as places to rule. He Who Remains warns that if he dies, variants like Kang will go to war across the multiverse.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Hope van Dyne learns about Kang the Conqueror from her mother when her family is trapped in the Quantum Realm. She fights him at his citadel, and she and Scott Lang defeat him in the final battle over his Multiversal Engine.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Obadiah Stane is Howard Stark's old friend and business partner, and he helps run Stark Industries with him. After Howard dies, Obadiah stays on to guide Howard's son Tony.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Howard Stark and Peggy Carter become close friends during the war.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: After the war, Peggy works in secret to clear Howard's name when he is accused of selling his weapons.

stages.title: Agent Carter (One-Shot)
stages.text: Together Howard and Peggy go on to found S.H.I.E.L.D., and Howard names her its head.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Hunter B-15 helps Mobius and Loki catch Hunter X-5 after he deserts the TVA to live as the actor Brad Wolfe, posing as a fan wanting his autograph so she can grab his TemPad. Back at the TVA, she locks him in holding until he talks about Sylvie.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: William Riva sends J. Jonah Jameson the edited footage of Mysterio's last battle, which Jameson broadcasts to the world.

stages.title: All Hail the King
stages.text: Jackson Norriss is a Ten Rings agent who serves Xu Wenwu, the real leader behind the Mandarin name. After Trevor Slattery mocks that legend, Norriss poses as a documentary filmmaker to get him out of Seagate prison and deliver him to his master.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Jean Grey learns about MJ from Peter's letter to her and hunts her down to get to Spider-Man. She possesses MJ and uses her body to taunt him, even kissing him while pretending to remember him.

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Karl Mordo and Kaecilius both come to Kamar-Taj as broken men, but Kaecilius turns on the order to serve Dormammu. Mordo fights his Zealots in the Mirror Dimension and in Hong Kong, and holds Kaecilius up to Strange as a warning of what pride can do.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Karen is the AI built into the suit Tony Stark gives Peter, unlocked once Ned disables the Training Wheels Protocol. She teaches him the suit's features and talks him through his fights, and Peter is the one who names her.

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Karl Mordo is the Ancient One's devoted student until he discovers she draws power from the Dark Dimension.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: When Reva Connors gets hold of footage of the experiments done on Kilgrave as a child, he forces her to reveal where she buried it. He then orders Jessica Jones to take care of her, and Jessica kills Reva under his control.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Natasha is one of the few people who know about Clint's secret family, and she and Laura become close friends. Laura welcomes her as an honorary aunt to the children and plans to name her third child after her.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Morgan Stark is Maria Stark's granddaughter, born to her son Tony and Pepper Potts long after Maria's death.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Skully, an old friend of Maya's family who runs a pawn shop in Tamaha, welcomes her home and builds her a new prosthetic leg. He also tells her about Chafa, the first Choctaw, from whom her family's power descends.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Roger Harrington is MJ's teacher, and he names her captain of the academic decathlon team when Liz Allan leaves. He chaperones the trip to Washington, often caught off guard by her pointed remarks, like her refusal to enter a monument built by slaves.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Mr. Charles is a CIA agent who works for Valentina Allegra de Fontaine, recruiting enhanced people for her.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Nobu Yoshioka is Murakami's second in command in the Hand, sent to New York to act on his behalf. Murakami stays in the shadows while Nobu deals with Wilson Fisk and works to claim a city block for the Hand.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Quentin Beck invents a holographic technology at Stark Industries, and Tony Stark rebrands it and fires him. Bitter at being cast aside, Beck becomes Mysterio and schemes to take Tony's legacy for himself.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: N'Jobu is King T'Chaka's brother, which makes him the great-uncle of Toussaint through his father, T'Challa. He dies long before Toussaint is born.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Nathaniel is named after Natasha, his parents' close friend and the children's honorary aunt. Clint and Laura first plan to call their baby Natasha, and send her a video of the newborn.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: William Ginter Riva works for Quentin Beck and helps run the drone illusions behind Mysterio. After Beck dies, Riva sends doctored footage to The Daily Bugle that frames Peter Parker for murder and reveals his identity to the world.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Quaz reads Scott Lang's mind when the freedom fighters bring him in, and mocks what he finds.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Toussaint is the son of T'Challa and Nakia, which makes T'Chaka his grandfather. T'Chaka dies years before the boy is born, so they never meet.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: The Collector and the Grandmaster are brothers. Both gather living beings for their own amusement, the Collector in his museum on Knowhere and the Grandmaster in his gladiator arena on Sakaar.

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Ultron is a prisoner inside White Vision's mind. When he tricks Vision into giving up control of his body, he takes Tommy.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Helmut Zemo frames Bucky to break the Avengers apart from within. In Siberia he shows Tony footage of Bucky killing his parents, and Tony turns on Steve and Bucky.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Agent Cleary of Damage Control sees footage of Kamala using her powers at AvengerCon and orders her brought in. When his agent Sadie Deever goes after Kamala and her friends at their school, he orders Deever to let them go.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Ultron learns of the multiverse when he notices the Watcher, then hunts him across worlds and nearly kills him.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Natasha takes the Guardians for Ultron's agents until Peggy speaks of her friendship with her own Natasha. They fight Ultron together, and Peggy exposes his eye for Natasha's arrow.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Hank joins the team sent to stop Peter and leads the attack on him at Coney Island.

stages.title: What If...?
stages.text: Hank finds Peter at his mother's grave, shares his own grief over his wife, and asks him to join their family. Peter agrees and turns on Ego with him, and afterward they celebrate at Hank's home.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Magneto kidnaps Rogue to power his machine, and Logan fights through the Brotherhood at the Statue of Liberty to save her.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: To stop Stryker, Logan works alongside a freed Magneto, until Magneto turns Stryker's Cerebro against every human on Earth.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Magneto leads the Brotherhood's attack on Alcatraz, and Logan keeps him busy while Beast injects him with the cure.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In a future ruled by Sentinels, Magneto fights beside Xavier and helps send Logan's mind back to 1973.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Mystique fights Logan at the train station and inside the Statue of Liberty, where he stabs her.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Mystique works with the X-Men against Stryker for a time, and teases Logan by taking Jean's form.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Sabretooth ambushes Logan and Rogue on a snowy road, then fights him again at the train station and on the Statue of Liberty.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Kayla and Logan live together in the Canadian Rockies, where she teaches school and tells him the legend that gives him the name Wolverine. Then she seems to be murdered by Victor.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Logan learns Kayla faked her death for Stryker to keep her sister safe, though her love for him was real. She frees the captives and dies, and he no longer remembers her.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Xavier reads Kurt's mind to learn who sent him after the President. Kurt then helps Storm free Xavier from Stryker's Cerebro.

stages.title: Logan
stages.text: Charles insists that Logan help Laura and treats her with a grandfather's warmth. After X-24 kills him, she stands with Logan at his grave.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: At the Statue of Liberty, Cyclops blasts Sabretooth out of the statue's head.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Jean and Storm find Kurt hiding in a church, and Jean reads his mind to learn about Stryker.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: At the Statue of Liberty, Storm strikes Toad with lightning, and he falls into the water.

stages.title: X-Men: First Class
stages.text: After Erik captures Emma in Russia, Charles reads her mind and learns Shaw's plan for war.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Inside the Statue of Liberty, Magneto pins Storm and the X-Men to the walls, and Storm tells him his machine will kill the leaders he means to change.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In the dark future, Storm and Magneto make a last stand together at the Chinese temple, where the Sentinels kill her.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Inside the Statue of Liberty, Magneto pins the X-Men to the walls and pulls off Scott's visor. Once Logan breaks free and distracts him, Scott blasts Magneto down so Logan can wreck the machine.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: At the train station, Toad snatches Scott's visor with his tongue. Inside the Statue of Liberty he locks Scott in a display case.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Inside the Statue of Liberty, Toad ambushes Jean and spits slime over her face, nearly smothering her.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Maria scoffs that the Illuminati can handle the Scarlet Witch, then faces her when she breaks into their base. As Captain Marvel she nearly overpowers her, but Wanda crushes her under a falling statue.

stages.title: Blade
stages.text: Blade stops Krieger from attacking Karen, then tracks him down and beats him until he talks about Frost.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: O'Reilly gets close to her fellow detective Connors while secretly investigating his drug dealing.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: When O'Reilly attacks Connors at Fuchs's memorial, he beats her in front of their colleagues. During the Terror outbreak he shoots her and drops her into the water.

stages.title: Cloak & Dagger
stages.text: Split in two by his bullet, O'Reilly's violent half, Mayhem, hunts Connors for revenge. After Adina kills him, Mayhem hangs his body at the police station with a sign calling him guilty, clearing Tyrone's name.

stages.title: Spider-Man (2002)
stages.text: Norman Osborn is Harry's father, and he takes a liking to Peter. As the Green Goblin, he learns Peter is Spider-Man, attacks May and drops Mary Jane from a bridge, then dies on his own glider, begging Peter not to tell Harry.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Pulled into another world just before his death, Norman faces Peter again at the Statue of Liberty. Peter stops that world's Peter from killing him and is stabbed in the back by the Goblin for it. Peter made the anti-serum himself, and once that world's Peter injects it, Norman is free of the Goblin.

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Otto Octavius is a brilliant scientist Peter admires. When they meet, Otto and his wife, Rosie, take to Peter at once, and Otto offers him advice on love and science.

stages.title: Spider-Man 2
stages.text: After the accident, Otto's arms drive him to rob a bank, kidnap Mary Jane and hand Spider-Man over to Harry. Peter unmasks and reminds him what he once believed, and Otto drowns his reactor, dying with it.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Pulled across worlds, Otto fights another Peter until a new inhibitor chip restores him. At the Statue of Liberty, he helps cure Electro and has a warm reunion with his old friend Peter.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Flint Marko is an escaped convict who becomes the Sandman, and Peter learns he is the real killer of Uncle Ben. Marko teams with Venom to kill Spider-Man, but in the end he says Ben's death was an accident, and Peter forgives him.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Pulled into another world, Marko only wants to get home to his daughter. At the Statue of Liberty, he chases Peter into the statue's crown, and Peter cures him there and promises to get him home.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Pulled into another world, Otto recognizes the Goblin as Norman Osborn, a man he thought was dead. Once Otto is cured, the Goblin calls him a lapdog and turns the others on him, and at the Statue of Liberty he slices off one of Otto's metal arms.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: When the Goblin turns the villains against Peter, Max blasts Otto out of the building. At the Statue of Liberty, Otto tears the arc reactor from Max's chest and puts the cure in its place.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Gwen Stacy is Peter's classmate, and she returns his feelings. He tells her he is Spider-Man, and she makes the antidote that cures the Lizard, but her dying father asks Peter to stay away from her.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Gwen breaks up with Peter over his guilt about her father, then they reconcile and he plans to follow her to Oxford. She helps him beat Electro, and she dies in a fall during his fight with the Green Goblin.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Years after Gwen's death, Peter tells the other Peters he can never forgive himself for failing to save her, and that losing her made him bitter. When another world's MJ falls at the Statue of Liberty, he catches her in time.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Dr. Curt Connors was Richard Parker's partner, and Peter gives him his father's missing equation. When Connors becomes the Lizard, Peter fights him until the antidote turns him back, and Connors then saves Peter from a fall.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Pulled into another world, the Lizard is caught and held in the Sanctum. Peter makes the antidote for him and holds him off at the Statue of Liberty, where that world's Peter uses it to turn him back into Connors.

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
stages.text: Spider-Man saves Max Dillon's life, and the lonely engineer comes to idolize him. Transformed into Electro, Max turns on him in Times Square, and Peter and Gwen overload him at a power station.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Pulled into another world, Max fights Peter at the Statue of Liberty and brushes off his pleas to let him help. Once Otto cures him, Peter tells Max he was never a nobody, and they part on good terms.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: In a world not his own, Peter faces another world's Green Goblin at the Statue of Liberty. He throws that world's Peter the anti-serum that cures Norman.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Max Dillon knew Curt Connors as a scientist at Oscorp in their own world. Held together in the Sanctum, they later escape and face the Spider-Men at the Statue of Liberty.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Pulled into another world, the Lizard leaps onto Peter at the Statue of Liberty and fights him on a falling crane. When the scaffolding collapses, Peter webs the cured Connors to safety.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Pulled into another world, Max and Flint first clash in the woods by a military research site, where Marko helps that world's Peter stop Max. Both are locked in the Sanctum, then side with the Goblin against Peter and fight the Spider-Men together at the Statue of Liberty.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1967)
stages.text: The Vulture captures Jameson at his clock tower hideout and learns about a military rocket from him, until Spider-Man rescues him.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: This Peter Parker from another world finds Peter grieving May and tells him how he lost Gwen Stacy. He works with him on the cures, throws him the Goblin's cure, and saves MJ when she falls from the Statue of Liberty.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Peter takes Norman Osborn in and tries to cure him, until the Goblin takes over, turns the others against him and fatally wounds May. At the Statue of Liberty Peter nearly kills him in revenge, then injects him with the cure that gives Norman back his mind.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Strange locks Norman Osborn in a Sanctum cell the moment he sees him and plans to send him home to die. At the Statue of Liberty the Goblin attacks him and blows open the box holding the spell.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Flint Marko first shields Peter from Electro and lets himself be taken in, wanting only to get home to his daughter. He breaks away when the Goblin turns the villains, and fights the Spider-Men at the Statue of Liberty until they cure him.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Curt Connors, still the Lizard, sits in a Sanctum cell when Peter first sees him. When the Goblin attacks, he breaks free and throws Peter through a window, and at the Statue of Liberty Peter tricks him into biting the cure.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: At the Statue of Liberty the Lizard chases Ned and MJ through Ned's portals to get the box holding the spell. MJ throws Peter his cure while Ned keeps them a step ahead.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: At the Statue of Liberty the Lizard chases MJ and Ned through portals to get the box holding the spell. MJ throws Peter the cure that turns him back into Curt Connors.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Searching for Peter with Strange's sling ring, Ned finds this Peter Parker instead and brings him home. They work together on the cures and the fight at the Statue of Liberty.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: MJ and Ned find this Peter Parker while searching for their own Peter. She helps him and the other Peters prepare the cures and lure the villains to the Statue of Liberty.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: MJ and Ned find this Peter Parker while searching for their own Peter. When she falls from the Statue of Liberty he catches her, a rescue he could not make for Gwen.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: After Xavier turns Spider-Man away, Beast tells him about Herbert Landon's cure for mutation. Landon's men then capture Beast, and Spider-Man helps rescue him.
